subject: literacy
concept: Recognizing consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th, wh) as single sounds made by two letters
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student physically joins two letter tiles into one 'digraph tile' and says the single sound it makes
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the digraph within a set of pictured words
exercise.abstract: Student identifies the digraph sound in a spoken word

misconception_flags: sounds out digraph letters separately instead of as one blended sound

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
